verdict.rationale: Martin generates proactive outputs from user data — daily/weekly briefings, proactive email drafts, and automated email triage/labeling — which function as AI-generated insights and suggestions, and community feedback confirms these background/proactive features are in active use. However, there's no evidence of dedicated data-analysis or trend/insight surfaces (e.g., dashboards, pattern summaries across tasks/notes) beyond task-execution and periodic briefings. Missing for 10: explicit insight/analytics generation beyond scheduling/email summaries, and independent verification of briefing/proactive-draft quality.
